item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00150","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C24","C05","C17"],"selected_candidate_label":"C24","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C24 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template for the child. Both orders create a presidential advisory body of designated members, authorize it to examine a defined governmental problem and recommend action to the President, direct all executive departments and agencies to cooperate and furnish information, and continue the body until the President terminates it by Executive order. Several provisions share closely matching language and occur in the same operative sequence. C05 and C17 contain weaker parallels involving a board or commission receiving information and interagency assistance, but neither matches the child's complete commission machinery as closely.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"There is hereby created a commission to be known as the President's Advisory Commission on the Relation of Federal Laws to Puerto Rico, which shall be composed of nine members to be designated by the President","parent_excerpt":"There shall be created in the national Military Establishment an advisory committee to be known as the President's Committee on Equality of Treatment and Opportunity in the Armed Services, which shall be composed of seven members to be designated by the President.","explanation":"Both establish a named presidential advisory body composed of a specified number of presidentially designated members."},{"child_excerpt":"The Commission shall from time to time make recommendations to the President... To that end, the Commission is authorized to examine into, and to hold hearings on, the inapplicability of Federal laws to Puerto Rico","parent_excerpt":"The Committee is authorized on behalf of the President to examine into the rules, procedures and practices of the armed services... and shall make such recommendations to the President","explanation":"The child adapts the same examine-and-recommend mandate to a new subject."},{"child_excerpt":"All executive departments and agencies of the Federal Government are authorized and directed to cooperate with the Commission in its work and to furnish the Commission such information as the Commission may require in the performance of its duties.","parent_excerpt":"All executive departments and agencies of the Federal Government are authorized and directed to cooperate with the Committee in its work, and to furnish the Committee such information or the services of such persons as the Committee may require in the performance of its duties.","explanation":"This is distinctive, nearly verbatim shared cooperation-and-information language."},{"child_excerpt":"The Commission shall continue to exist until the President terminates its existence by Executive order.","parent_excerpt":"The Committee shall continue to exist until such time as the President shall terminate its existence by Executive order.","explanation":"The termination provision is nearly verbatim and occupies the same closing position."}]}
